End of 2023, deluxe edition, and my saves keep crashing all the time, making me lose a lot of progress having to load an older save. Very often I have to load a very old save because after certain point all auto and manual saves are crashed.

Do not play this game, Andromeda is not bad but it is not worth it, I have played for almost 30 hours and at least 3 of these hours was replaying stuff because of this f****** problem.

And guess what? I am not finishing the game because of this. Thanks, EA and Bioware.

Game from 2017 that is still, to this very day plagued by bugs and other issues. Visually very pretty, gunplay is okay, but atleast in the first five hours I can safely say that it is not on the same level as the OG trilogy. The characters range from semi-interesting to having the personality of a wet tissue paper. The whole premise with the Arks and settling new worlds is catchy, at least in my case, sadly I can't continue any further because of a game-breaking bug which is apparently unfixable, no amount of reloading saves, different approaches or even starting a whole new game seems to fix it. If you're thinking of getting Mass Effect, get the Legendary Edition which is thousand times better, AND actually works. As for Andromeda itself, if you really want to, buy it cheap during a big sale if you really, really, really want to try it out.

This game is much better than people give it credit for.  The story is cookie cutter mass effect but the game play and combat are really well done.  At launch people had problems with the bugs and facial expressions but the company listened to the fans and fixed the issues, for the most part, pretty quick.  They kept some of the facial expressions but toned them down because, you know, do it for the meme.

I can't believe how big a deal people made about the eyes and face animations when this launched.  Wondering if the wonky eyes was purposely done to distract from the fact that the entire first hour of the game has almost no game play.
